description: 3D railways is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Geometric and conventional representation of the rail system for planning purposes. This geospatial data is structured according to the following layers of information; - CARTO-IR-ACCESSORY: level crossing barrier & level pass lantern - CARTO-FER-DEBARCADERE: dock for the embarkation/disembarkation of goods or passengers - CARTO-FER-PONT: railway engineering structure making it possible to cross an obstacle - ... Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are PolearTM, SIRR, railway, Railroad, Government information. It offers 3 resource(s) in GPKG, HTML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
